diaphragm.origin: xiphoid process, costal margin, fascia over the quadratus lumborum and psoas major mm.(lateral & medial arcuate ligaments), vertebral bodies L1-L3
diaphragm.action: pushes the abdominal viscera inferiorly, increasing the volume of the thoracic cavity (inspiration)

external oblique.insertion: 白線、恥骨結節及髂嵴前部。
external oblique.action: 雙側參與軀幹屈曲及腹壓；單側使軀幹向同側側屈、向對側旋轉。
external oblique.fibers: 主要由外上方向內下方，後部肌束較縱向。
external oblique.relations: 腹側壁三層扁肌的最淺層；內側為腱膜，並非整片腹部都由肌腹覆蓋。
external oblique.distinction: 旋轉方向以軀幹相對骨盆而言；右腹外斜肌參與軀幹向左旋轉。

sternohyoid.origin: posterior surfaces of both the manubrium and sternal end of the clavicle
sternohyoid.insertion: lower border of the hyoid bone, medial to the omohyoid m. insertion

omohyoid.origin: inferior belly: upper border of the scapula medial to the scapular notch; superior belly: intermediate tendon
omohyoid.insertion: inferior belly: intermediate tendon; superior belly: lower border of the hyoid bone lateral to the sternohyoid insertion

sternothyroid.origin: posterior surface of the manubrium below the origin of the sternohyoid m.
sternothyroid.insertion: oblique line of the thyroid cartilage

thyrohyoid.origin: oblique line of the thyroid cartilage
thyrohyoid.insertion: lower border of the hyoid bone
thyrohyoid.action: elevates the larynx; depresses/stabilizes the hyoid bone
thyrohyoid.nerve: ansa cervicalis (via fibers running with the hypoglossal nerve that leave XII distal to the superior limb of ansa)

latissimus dorsi.origin: 下胸椎棘突、胸腰筋膜、髂嵴及下方肋骨。
latissimus dorsi.action: 肩關節伸展、內收與內旋。
latissimus dorsi.fibers: 寬廣肌束向外上方匯聚，止端肌腱有扭轉。
latissimus dorsi.relations: 覆蓋下背外側，向腋窩後襞延伸；與大圓肌相鄰。
latissimus dorsi.distinction: 闊背肌止於溝底；胸大肌在外側唇、大圓肌在內側唇，三者附著處不同。

pectoralis minor.origin: 第 3–5 肋骨、靠近肋軟骨處。
pectoralis minor.action: 將肩胛骨向前下方牽引並協助穩定；肩胛固定時可輔助吸氣。
pectoralis minor.fibers: 由肋骨向外上方匯聚至喙突。
pectoralis minor.relations: 胸大肌深面，作用於肩胛骨。
pectoralis minor.distinction: 胸小肌止於肩胛骨，不是像胸大肌一樣止於肱骨。

rectus abdominis.action: 軀幹屈曲、骨盆後傾，並參與腹壓與軀幹控制。
rectus abdominis.nerve: 下胸段胸腹神經（含肋下神經）。
rectus abdominis.fibers: 肌束主要縱向；橫向分隔是腱劃，不是肌纖維改成橫向。
rectus abdominis.relations: 位於腹直肌鞘內，中線兩側由白線分開。
rectus abdominis.distinction: 所謂六塊肌是同一對長肌被腱劃分隔；不是六條獨立肌肉，也不只負責動作。

rhomboid major.insertion: medial border of the scapula inferior to the spine of the scapula
rhomboid major.action: retracts, elevates and rotates the scapula inferiorly

rhomboid minor.origin: inferior end of the ligamentum nuchae, spines of vertebrae C7 and T1
rhomboid minor.insertion: medial border of the scapula at the root of the spine of the scapula
rhomboid minor.action: retracts, elevates and rotates the scapula inferiorly

scalenus posterior.origin: posterior tubercles of the transverse processes of vertebrae C5-C7
scalenus posterior.insertion: lateral surface of the second rib
scalenus posterior.action: elevates the second rib; flexes and laterally bends the neck

scalenus medius.origin: posterior tubercles of the transverse processes of vertebrae C2-C7
scalenus medius.insertion: upper surface of the first rib behind the subclavian artery
scalenus medius.action: elevates the first rib; flexes and laterally bends the neck

scalenus anterior.origin: anterior tubercles of the transverse processes of vertebrae C3-C6
scalenus anterior.insertion: scalene tubercle of the first rib
scalenus anterior.action: elevates the first rib; flexes and laterally bends the neck

serratus anterior.origin: 第 1–8 或第 9 肋骨外側面。
serratus anterior.insertion: 肩胛骨內側緣肋面，下部肌束至下角附近。
serratus anterior.action: 肩胛前伸、上旋及貼附胸廓。
serratus anterior.fibers: 肋骨端呈鋸齒狀肌指，肌束繞胸廓向後至肩胛骨。
serratus anterior.relations: 位於胸廓外側，深入肩胛骨前方；鋸齒狀只是可見的一部分。
serratus anterior.distinction: 翼狀肩胛可有不同神經與肌肉原因；不能見到翼狀就一律判定前鋸肌無力。

serratus posterior superior.origin: ligamentum nuchae, spines of vertebrae C7 and T1-T3
serratus posterior superior.nerve: branches of the ventral primary rami of spinal nerves T1-T4

serratus posterior inferior.origin: thoracolumbar fascia, spines of vertebrae T11-T12 and L1-L2
serratus posterior inferior.nerve: branches of the ventral primary rami of spinal nerves T9-T12

sternocleidomastoid.origin: 胸骨頭：胸骨柄；鎖骨頭：鎖骨內側段。
sternocleidomastoid.insertion: 顳骨乳突及上項線外側部。
sternocleidomastoid.action: 單側：同側側屈、對側旋轉；雙側可屈下頸段並伸展上頸段。
sternocleidomastoid.nerve: 副神經（CN XI）；頸神經分支參與本體覺。
sternocleidomastoid.fibers: 兩頭由前內下方向後外上方匯合。
sternocleidomastoid.relations: 頸部表層；與斜方肌界定頸後三角。
sternocleidomastoid.distinction: 不能把整個頸部當成單一鉸鏈；上、下頸段的動作可不同。

subclavius.action: draws the clavicle (and hence the shoulder) down and forward

subscapularis.insertion: 肱骨小結節，與前側關節囊融合。
subscapularis.fibers: 多束由肩胛骨肋面向外側匯聚。
subscapularis.relations: 位於肩胛骨前方（肋面）、胸廓後方；背面完整肩胛骨會遮住它。
subscapularis.distinction: 「肩胛下」是肩胛骨的前面，不能畫在肩胛棘下窩；那裡是棘下肌。

internal oblique.origin: 胸腰筋膜、髂嵴及腹股溝韌帶外側部。
internal oblique.insertion: 第 10–12 肋骨下緣、白線及恥骨梳。
internal oblique.action: 雙側參與軀幹屈曲與腹壓；單側參與同側側屈與同側旋轉。
internal oblique.nerve: 下胸神經、肋下神經及 L1 分支。
internal oblique.fibers: 上部多由外下方向內上方；下部較橫向或向內下。
internal oblique.relations: 位於腹外斜肌深面、腹橫肌淺面，是中間層。
internal oblique.distinction: 與同側腹外斜肌的主要旋轉方向不同；不能省略中間這一層。

external anal sphincter.origin: perineal body or central tendinous point of the perineum
external anal sphincter.insertion: encircles the anal canal; superficial fibers attach to the coccyx
external anal sphincter.nerve: inferior rectal nerves (from the pudendal nerve)

iliacus.origin: iliac fossa and iliac crest; ala of sacrum
iliacus.action: flexes the thigh; if the thigh is fixed it flexes the pelvis on the thigh

obturator internus.origin: the internal surface of the obturator membrane and margin of the obturator foramen
obturator internus.insertion: greater trochanter on its medial surface above the trochanteric fossa
obturator internus.action: laterally rotates and abducts the thigh
obturator internus.nerve: nerve to the obturator internus m.

obturator externus.origin: the external surface of the obturator membrane and the superior and inferior pubic rami

gluteus maximus.origin: 髂骨後部、薦骨、尾骨及薦結節韌帶附近。
gluteus maximus.insertion: 髂脛束與股骨臀肌粗隆。
gluteus maximus.action: 髖伸展、外旋；各區可協助外展或內收。
gluteus maximus.fibers: 寬厚肌束由內上方向外下方排列。
gluteus maximus.relations: 臀部表層，覆蓋部分臀中肌與深層外旋肌。
gluteus maximus.distinction: 久坐不能直接推論臀大肌失去啟動能力；功能須依動作與負荷評估。

gluteus medius.origin: 髂骨外面前、後臀線之間。
gluteus medius.action: 髖外展；支撐側收縮有助維持骨盆水平；各區旋轉作用與髖角度有關。
gluteus medius.fibers: 扇形、多個功能區的肌束向大轉子匯聚。
gluteus medius.relations: 在臀小肌淺面，後部被臀大肌遮蓋。
gluteus medius.distinction: 對側骨盆下掉可提示支撐側外展肌功能問題，但不是單靠姿勢就能確診哪條肌肉無力。

gluteus minimus.origin: external surface of the ilium between the anterior and inferior gluteal lines
gluteus minimus.action: abducts the femur; medially rotates the thigh

gemellus superior.nerve: nerve to the obturator internus m.

gemellus inferior.nerve: nerve to the quadratus femoris m.

quadratus femoris.origin: lateral border of the ischial tuberosity
quadratus femoris.insertion: quadrate line of the femur below the intertrochanteric crest
quadratus femoris.nerve: nerve to the quadratus femoris m.

piriformis.action: 伸髖位時參與髖外旋；屈髖時參與外展。
piriformis.nerve: 梨狀肌神經（薦神經叢分支）。
piriformis.fibers: 由薦骨向外側、經坐骨大孔至大轉子。
piriformis.relations: 臀大肌深面；坐骨神經通常由其下方通過，存在變異。
piriformis.distinction: 臀部或腿後側麻痛有多種原因，不能直接由肌肉位置診斷梨狀肌症候群。

psoas major.origin: bodies and transverse processes of lumbar vertebrae
psoas major.insertion: lesser trochanter of femur (with iliacus) via iliopsoas tendon
psoas major.action: flexes the thigh; flexes & laterally bends the lumbar vertebral column
psoas major.nerve: branches of the ventral primary rami of spinal nerves L2-L4

transversus abdominis.origin: 下六根肋軟骨內面、胸腰筋膜、髂嵴及腹股溝韌帶外側部。
transversus abdominis.insertion: 經腱膜至白線、恥骨嵴／恥骨梳。
transversus abdominis.action: 壓縮腹內容物，參與腹壓、呼吸與軀幹控制。
transversus abdominis.nerve: 下胸神經、肋下神經及 L1 分支。
transversus abdominis.relations: 腹側壁三層扁肌中最深層，在腹內斜肌深面。
transversus abdominis.distinction: 腹部內收動作不能證明只啟動腹橫肌；核心控制由多條肌肉共同完成。

pyramidalis.origin: pubis, anterior to the rectus abdominis

quadratus lumborum.insertion: 第 12 肋骨下緣及 L1–L4 橫突。
quadratus lumborum.action: 傳統描述包括腰部同側側屈、固定第 12 肋；亦參與骨盆與軀幹控制。
quadratus lumborum.nerve: 第 12 胸神經及上腰神經前支。
quadratus lumborum.fibers: 含髂肋、髂腰及腰肋等不同方向的肌束，不宜畫成完全平行的直紋。
quadratus lumborum.relations: 後腹壁肌，在豎脊肌前方、腰大肌外側。
quadratus lumborum.distinction: 複雜肌束的實際力學貢獻仍有研究討論，不能只由外觀判定為下背痛來源。

sartorius.insertion: medial surface of the tibia (pes anserinus)
sartorius.action: flexes, abducts and laterally rotates the thigh; flexes leg

semitendinosus.origin: lower, medial surface of ischial tuberosity (common tendon with biceps femoris m.)
semitendinosus.insertion: medial surface of tibia (via pes anserinus)
semitendinosus.action: extends the thigh, flexes the leg

tensor fasciae latae.insertion: 髂脛束，再連至近端脛骨外側。
tensor fasciae latae.action: 屈髖、外展、內旋，並張緊髂脛束。
tensor fasciae latae.fibers: 短肌腹向遠端筋膜帶延伸。
tensor fasciae latae.relations: 髖前外側，在闊筋膜兩層之間。
tensor fasciae latae.distinction: 它是正常的髖外展協同肌；參與抬腿不等於一定代償。

semimembranosus.origin: upper, outer surface of the ischial tuberosity
semimembranosus.action: extends the thigh, flexes the leg

pectineus.action: adducts, flexes, and medially rotates the thigh
pectineus.nerve: femoral nerve and possibly the anterior division of the obturator nerve

adductor brevis.insertion: pectineal line and linea aspera (deep to the pectineus and adductor longus mm.)
adductor brevis.action: adducts, flexes, and medially rotates the femur
adductor brevis.nerve: anterior division of the obturator nerve

adductor longus.origin: medial portion of the superior pubic ramus
adductor longus.action: adducts, flexes, and medially rotates the femur
adductor longus.nerve: anterior division of the obturator nerve

adductor magnus.insertion: linea aspera of the femur; the ischiocondylar part inserts on the adductor tubercle of the femur
adductor magnus.action: adducts, flexes, and medially rotates the femur; extends the femur (ischiocondylar part)
adductor magnus.nerve: posterior division of the obturator nerve; tibial nerve (ischiocondylar part)

tibialis anterior.origin: 脛骨外側髁、近端外側面及骨間膜。
tibialis anterior.insertion: 內側楔骨與第 1 蹠骨基底內側。
tibialis anterior.action: 踝背屈與足內翻；走路時也控制足部落下。
tibialis anterior.fibers: 肌腹與內部腱膜形成羽狀排列，遠端變成長肌腱。
tibialis anterior.relations: 小腿前肌區，緊鄰脛骨外側；肌腱跨踝前方至足內側。
tibialis anterior.distinction: 腓骨長、短肌的肌腱繞外踝後方，與脛前肌跨踝前方不同。

extensor hallucis longus.origin: middle half of the anterior surface of the fibula and the interosseous membrane
extensor hallucis longus.insertion: base of the distal phalanx of the great toe
extensor hallucis longus.action: extends the metatarsophalangeal interphalangeal joints of the great toe

extensor digitorum longus.origin: lateral condyle of the tibia, anterior surface of the fibula, lateral portion of the interosseous membrane
extensor digitorum longus.insertion: dorsum of the lateral 4 toes via extensor expansions (central slip inserts on base of middle phalanx, lateral slips on base of distal phalanx)
extensor digitorum longus.action: extends the metatarsophalangeal, proximal interphalangeal and distal interphalangeal joints of the lateral 4 toes

fibularis tertius.origin: distal part of the anterior surface of the fibula
fibularis tertius.insertion: dorsum of the shaft of the 5th metatarsal bone

fibularis longus.origin: upper two/thirds of the lateral surface of the fibula
fibularis longus.insertion: after crossing the plantar surface of the foot deep to the intrinsic muscles, it inserts on the medial cuneiform and the base of the 1st metatarsal bone
fibularis longus.action: extends (plantar flexes) and everts the foot

fibularis brevis.origin: lower one third of the lateral surface of the fibula
fibularis brevis.insertion: tuberosity of the base of the 5th metatarsal
fibularis brevis.action: extends (plantar flexes) and everts the foot

soleus.origin: 腓骨頭與近端後面、脛骨比目魚肌線及腱弓。
soleus.action: 踝蹠屈及站立控制；不跨膝關節。
soleus.fibers: 寬扁肌腹，具有複雜羽狀排列。
soleus.relations: 小腿後肌區淺群，在腓腸肌深面；「較深」不等於後肌區的深群。
soleus.distinction: 屈膝會改變腓腸肌的力學條件，使比目魚肌相對貢獻增加，但不代表完全孤立。

plantaris.origin: above the lateral femoral condyle (above the lateral head of gastrocnemius)
plantaris.insertion: dorsum of the calcaneus medial to the calcaneal tendon
plantaris.action: flexes the leg; plantar flexes the foot

popliteus.insertion: posterior surface of the tibia above soleal line
popliteus.action: flexes and rotates the leg medially (with the foot planted, it rotates the thigh laterally)

splenius cervicis.origin: ligamentum nuchae and spines of C7-T6 vertebrae
splenius cervicis.insertion: posterior tubercles of the transverse processes of C1-C3 vertebrae
splenius cervicis.action: extends and laterally bends neck and head, rotates head to the same side
splenius cervicis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C2-C6

splenius capitis.origin: ligamentum nuchae and spines of C7-T6 vertebrae
splenius capitis.insertion: mastoid process and lateral end of the superior nuchal line
splenius capitis.action: extends and laterally bends the neck and head, rotates head to the same side
splenius capitis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C2-C6

iliocostalis lumborum.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 iliocostalis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
iliocostalis lumborum.action: extends and laterally bends the trunk and neck
iliocostalis lumborum.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C4-S5
iliocostalis lumborum.partOrigin: 後髂嵴、薦骨與腰薦部共同腱。
iliocostalis lumborum.partInsertion: 下位肋骨肋角及相關腰椎附著。
iliocostalis lumborum.partAction: 雙側伸展軀幹；單側同側側彎。

iliocostalis thoracis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 iliocostalis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
iliocostalis thoracis.action: extends and laterally bends the trunk and neck
iliocostalis thoracis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C4-S5
iliocostalis thoracis.partInsertion: 上位肋骨肋角與第七頸椎橫突。

iliocostalis cervicis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 iliocostalis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
iliocostalis cervicis.action: extends and laterally bends the trunk and neck
iliocostalis cervicis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C4-S5
iliocostalis cervicis.partInsertion: 中下位頸椎橫突後結節。

longissimus thoracis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 longissimus 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
longissimus thoracis.origin: transverse process at inferior vertebral levels
longissimus thoracis.insertion: transverse process at superior vertebral levels and mastoid process
longissimus thoracis.action: extends and laterally bends the trunk, neck and head
longissimus thoracis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C1-S1
longissimus thoracis.partOrigin: 腰薦部共同腱與腰椎橫突。
longissimus thoracis.partInsertion: 胸椎橫突及肋骨肋結節與肋角間區域。

longissimus capitis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 longissimus 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
longissimus capitis.origin: transverse process at inferior vertebral levels
longissimus capitis.insertion: transverse process at superior vertebral levels and mastoid process
longissimus capitis.action: extends and laterally bends the trunk, neck and head
longissimus capitis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C1-S1
longissimus capitis.partOrigin: 上位胸椎橫突及下位頸椎關節突。
longissimus capitis.partAction: 伸頭、同側側彎與同側旋轉。

longissimus cervicis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 longissimus 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
longissimus cervicis.origin: transverse process at inferior vertebral levels
longissimus cervicis.insertion: transverse process at superior vertebral levels and mastoid process
longissimus cervicis.action: extends and laterally bends the trunk, neck and head
longissimus cervicis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C1-S1

spinalis thoracis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 spinalis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
spinalis thoracis.origin: spinous processes at inferior vertebral levels
spinalis thoracis.insertion: spinous processes at superior vertebral levels and base of the skull
spinalis thoracis.action: extends and laterally bends trunk and neck
spinalis thoracis.nerve: dorsal primary rami of spinal nerves C2-L3

third plantar interosseous of foot.insertion: bases of proximal phalanges and extensor expansions of digits 3-5
third plantar interosseous of foot.action: adduct digits 3-5 (move these digits toward the midline of the foot as defined by the second digit),flex metatarsophalangeal and extend interphalangeal joints of digits 3-5
third plantar interosseous of foot.nerve: deep branch of the lateral plantar nerve
third plantar interosseous of foot.partInsertion: 第 5 趾近節趾骨底內側與伸肌腱膜。
third plantar interosseous of foot.partAction: 將第 5 趾內收朝向第二趾，並協助屈蹠趾關節。

second plantar interosseous of foot.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 plantar interosseous 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
second plantar interosseous of foot.origin: base and medial side of metatarsals 3-5
second plantar interosseous of foot.insertion: bases of proximal phalanges and extensor expansions of digits 3-5
second plantar interosseous of foot.action: adduct digits 3-5 (move these digits toward the midline of the foot as defined by the second digit),flex metatarsophalangeal and extend interphalangeal joints of digits 3-5
second plantar interosseous of foot.nerve: deep branch of the lateral plantar nerve
second plantar interosseous of foot.partInsertion: 第 4 趾近節趾骨底內側與伸肌腱膜。
second plantar interosseous of foot.partAction: 將第 4 趾內收朝向第二趾，並協助屈蹠趾關節。

first plantar interosseous of foot.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 plantar interosseous 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
first plantar interosseous of foot.origin: base and medial side of metatarsals 3-5
first plantar interosseous of foot.insertion: bases of proximal phalanges and extensor expansions of digits 3-5
first plantar interosseous of foot.action: adduct digits 3-5 (move these digits toward the midline of the foot as defined by the second digit),flex metatarsophalangeal and extend interphalangeal joints of digits 3-5
first plantar interosseous of foot.nerve: deep branch of the lateral plantar nerve

pronator quadratus.origin: medial side of the anterior surface of the distal one-fourth of the ulna
pronator quadratus.insertion: anterior surface of the distal one-fourth of the radius
pronator quadratus.nerve: median nerve via the anterior interosseous nerve

flexor carpi radialis.origin: common flexor tendon from the medial epicondyle of the humerus
flexor carpi radialis.insertion: base of the second and third metacarpals
flexor carpi radialis.action: flexes the wrist, abducts the hand

palmaris longus.origin: common flexor tendon, from the medial epicondyle of the humerus

flexor digitorum profundus.origin: posterior border of the ulna, proximal two-thirds of medial border of ulna, interosseous membrane
flexor digitorum profundus.insertion: base of the distal phalanx of digits 2-5
flexor digitorum profundus.action: flexes the metacarpophalangeal, proximal interphalangeal and distal interphalangeal joints
flexor digitorum profundus.nerve: median nerve (radial one-half); ulnar nerve (ulnar one-half)

flexor pollicis longus.origin: anterior surface of radius and interosseous membrane
flexor pollicis longus.insertion: base of the distal phalanx of the thumb
flexor pollicis longus.action: flexes the metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints of the thumb

brachioradialis.origin: upper two-thirds of the lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus
brachioradialis.insertion: lateral side of the base of the styloid process of the radius
brachioradialis.action: flexes the elbow, assists in pronation & supination

extensor carpi radialis longus.origin: lower one-third of the lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus
extensor carpi radialis longus.insertion: dorsum of the second metacarpal bone (base)
extensor carpi radialis longus.action: extends the wrist; abducts the hand
extensor carpi radialis longus.nerve: 橈神經（在分為淺、深支前發出肌支）。

extensor carpi radialis brevis.origin: 肱骨外上髁的共同伸肌腱起點。
extensor carpi radialis brevis.insertion: dorsum of the third metacarpal bone (base)
extensor carpi radialis brevis.action: extends the wrist; abducts the hand
extensor carpi radialis brevis.nerve: 橈神經深支；分支來源有解剖變異。

extensor digitorum.origin: common extensor tendon (lateral epicondyle of the humerus)
extensor digitorum.action: extends the metacarpophalangeal, proximal interphalangeal and distal interphalangeal joints of the 2nd-5th digits; extends wrist

extensor digiti minimi.origin: common extensor tendon (lateral epicondyle of the humerus)
extensor digiti minimi.insertion: joins the extensor digitorum tendon to the 5th digit and inserts into the extensor expansion
extensor digiti minimi.action: extends the metacarpophalangeal, proximal interphalangeal and distal interphalangeal joints of the 5th digit

supinator.origin: lateral epicondyle of the humerus, supinator crest & fossa of the ulna, radial collateral ligament, annular ligament
supinator.insertion: lateral side of proximal one-third of the radius

abductor pollicis longus.origin: middle one-third of the posterior surface of the radius, interosseous membrane, mid-portion of posterolateral ulna
abductor pollicis longus.insertion: radial side of the base of the first metacarpal
abductor pollicis longus.action: abducts the thumb at carpometacarpal joint

extensor pollicis brevis.origin: interosseous membrane and the posterior surface of the distal radius
extensor pollicis brevis.insertion: base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
extensor pollicis brevis.action: extends the thumb at the metacarpophalangeal joint

extensor pollicis longus.origin: interosseous membrane and middle part of the posterolateral surface of the ulna
extensor pollicis longus.insertion: base of the distal phalanx of the thumb
extensor pollicis longus.action: extends the thumb at the interphalangeal joint

extensor indicis.origin: interosseous membrane and the posterolateral surface of the distal ulna
extensor indicis.insertion: its tendon joins the tendon of the extensor digitorum to the second digit; both tendons insert into the extensor expansion
extensor indicis.action: extends the index finger at the metacarpophalangeal, proximal interphalangeal and distal interphalangeal joints

notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
humeral head of pronator teres.origin: common flexor tendon and (deep or ulnar head) from medial side of coronoid process of the ulna
humeral head of pronator teres.insertion: midpoint of the lateral side of the shaft of the radius
humeral head of pronator teres.partInsertion: midpoint of the lateral side of the shaft of the radius

ulnar head of pronator teres.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 pronator teres 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。

ulnar head of pronator teres.origin: common flexor tendon and (deep or ulnar head) from medial side of coronoid process of the ulna
ulnar head of pronator teres.insertion: midpoint of the lateral side of the shaft of the radius
ulnar head of pronator teres.partInsertion: midpoint of the lateral side of the shaft of the radius

humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris.key: humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris
humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris.english: humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris
humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 flexor carpi ulnaris 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris.origin: common flexor tendon & (ulnar head) from medial border of olecranon & upper 2/3 of the posterior border of the ulna
humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris.insertion: pisiform, hook of hamate, and base of 5th metacarpal
humeral head of flexor carpi ulnaris.partInsertion: pisiform, hook of hamate, and base of 5th metacarpal

ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris.key: ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris
ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris.english: ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris
ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 flexor carpi ulnaris 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris.origin: common flexor tendon & (ulnar head) from medial border of olecranon & upper 2/3 of the posterior border of the ulna
ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris.insertion: pisiform, hook of hamate, and base of 5th metacarpal
ulnar head of flexor carpi ulnaris.partInsertion: pisiform, hook of hamate, and base of 5th metacarpal

humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.key: humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum superficialis
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.english: humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum superficialis
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 flexor digitorum superficialis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.origin: humeroulnar head: common flexor tendon; radial head: middle 1/3 of radius
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.insertion: shafts of the middle phalanges of digits 2-5
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.action: flexes the metacarpophalangeal and proximal interphalangeal joints
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.partOrigin: 肱骨內上髁、尺側副韌帶與尺骨冠突。
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.partInsertion: shafts of the middle phalanges of digits 2-5
humeroulnar head of flexor digitorum sup.partAction: flexes the metacarpophalangeal and proximal interphalangeal joints

radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.key: radial head of flexor digitorum superficialis
radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.english: radial head of flexor digitorum superficialis
radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 flexor digitorum superficialis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.origin: humeroulnar head: common flexor tendon; radial head: middle 1/3 of radius
radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.insertion: shafts of the middle phalanges of digits 2-5
radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.action: flexes the metacarpophalangeal and proximal interphalangeal joints
radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.partInsertion: shafts of the middle phalanges of digits 2-5
radial head of flexor digitorum superfic.partAction: flexes the metacarpophalangeal and proximal interphalangeal joints

rectus femoris.origin: straight head: anterior inferior iliac spine; reflected head: above the superior rim of the acetabulum
rectus femoris.insertion: patella and tibial tuberosity (via the patellar ligament)
rectus femoris.action: extends the leg, flexes the thigh

vastus lateralis.origin: lateral intermuscular septum, lateral lip of the linea aspera and the gluteal tuberosity

vastus medialis.origin: medial intermuscular septum, medial lip of the linea aspera

vastus intermedius.origin: anterior and lateral surface of the femur

set of lumbricals of hand.dataScope: 模型將多條肌肉合為一個肌群；資料也是肌群層級。
set of lumbricals of hand.origin: flexor digitorum profundus tendons of digits 2-5
set of lumbricals of hand.insertion: extensor expansion on the radial side of the proximal phalanx of digits 2-5
set of lumbricals of hand.action: flex the metacarpophalangeal joints, extend the proximal and distal interphalangeal joints of digits 2-5
set of lumbricals of hand.nerve: median nerve (radial 2) via palmar digital nerves & ulnar nerve (ulnar 2) via deep branch

set of palmar interossei of hand.key: set of palmar interossei of hand
set of palmar interossei of hand.english: set of palmar interossei of hand
set of palmar interossei of hand.dataScope: 模型將多條肌肉合為一個肌群；資料也是肌群層級。
set of palmar interossei of hand.origin: four muscles, arising from the palmar surface of the shafts of metacarpals 1, 2, 4, & 5 (the 1st palmar interosseous is often fused with the adductor pollicis m.)
set of palmar interossei of hand.insertion: base of the proximal phalanx and extensor expansion of the medial side of digits 1 & 2, and lateral side of digits 4 & 5
set of palmar interossei of hand.action: flexes the metacarpophalangeal, extends proximal and distal interphalangeal joints and adducts digits 1, 2, 4, & 5 (adduction of the digits of the hand is in reference to the midline of the 3rd digit)

set of dorsal interossei of hand.key: set of dorsal interossei of hand
set of dorsal interossei of hand.english: set of dorsal interossei of hand
set of dorsal interossei of hand.dataScope: 模型將多條肌肉合為一個肌群；資料也是肌群層級。
set of dorsal interossei of hand.origin: four muscles, each arising from two adjacent metacarpal shafts
set of dorsal interossei of hand.insertion: base of the proximal phalanx and the extensor expansion on lateral side of the 2nd digit, lateral & medial sides of the 3rd digit, and medial side of the 4th digit
set of dorsal interossei of hand.action: flex the metacarpophalangeal joint, extend the proximal and distal interphalangeal joints of digits 2-4, abduct digits 2-4 (abduction of digits in the hand is defined as movement away from the midline of the 3rd digit)

gracilis.origin: pubic symphysis and the inferior pubic ramus
gracilis.insertion: medial surface of the tibia (via pes anserinus)
gracilis.action: adducts the thigh, flexes and medially rotates the thigh, flexes the leg
gracilis.nerve: anterior division of the obturator nerve

adductor minimus.origin: lower portion of the inferior pubic ramus
adductor minimus.insertion: gluteal ridge and upper part of the linea aspera of the femur
adductor minimus.action: adducts and laterally rotates the femur
adductor minimus.nerve: posterior division of the obturator nerve

platysma.origin: fascia overlying the pectoralis major and deltoid muscles
platysma.insertion: inferior border of the mandible and skin of lower face
platysma.action: draws the corners of the mouth down; it aids in depression of the mandible
platysma.nerve: cervical branch of the facial nerve (VII)

stylohyoid.origin: posterior side of the styloid process
stylohyoid.insertion: splits around the intermediate tendon of the digastric m. to insert on the body of the hyoid bone
stylohyoid.action: elevates and retracts the hyoid bone

pubococcygeus.origin: posterior aspect of the superior pubic ramis
pubococcygeus.nerve: branches of the ventral primary rami of spinal nerves S3-S4

puborectalis.origin: posterior aspect of the body of the pubis
puborectalis.insertion: unites with the puborectalis m. of other side posterior to the rectum
puborectalis.action: draws the distal rectum forward and superiorly; aids in voluntary retention of feces
puborectalis.nerve: branches of the ventral primary rami of spinal nerves S3-S4

iliococcygeus.origin: arcus tendineus levator ani and the ischial spine
iliococcygeus.nerve: branches of the ventral primary rami of spinal nerves S3-S4

abdominal part of pectoralis major.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 pectoralis major 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
abdominal part of pectoralis major.origin: medial 1/2 of the clavicle, manubrium & body of sternum, costal cartilages of ribs 2-6, sometimes from the rectus sheath of the upper abdominal wall
abdominal part of pectoralis major.insertion: crest of the greater tubercle of the humerus
abdominal part of pectoralis major.action: flexes and adducts the arm, medially rotates the arm
abdominal part of pectoralis major.partInsertion: crest of the greater tubercle of the humerus
abdominal part of pectoralis major.partAction: flexes and adducts the arm, medially rotates the arm

long head of biceps femoris.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 biceps femoris 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
long head of biceps femoris.origin: long head: ischial tuberosity; short head: lateral lip of the linea aspera
long head of biceps femoris.insertion: head of fibula and lateral condyle of the tibia
long head of biceps femoris.action: extends the thigh, flexes the leg
long head of biceps femoris.nerve: long head: tibial nerve; short head: common fibular (peroneal) nerve
long head of biceps femoris.partNerve: 坐骨神經的脛神經部分。
long head of biceps femoris.partInsertion: head of fibula and lateral condyle of the tibia
long head of biceps femoris.partAction: extends the thigh, flexes the leg

short head of biceps femoris.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 biceps femoris 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
short head of biceps femoris.origin: long head: ischial tuberosity; short head: lateral lip of the linea aspera
short head of biceps femoris.insertion: head of fibula and lateral condyle of the tibia
short head of biceps femoris.action: extends the thigh, flexes the leg
short head of biceps femoris.nerve: long head: tibial nerve; short head: common fibular (peroneal) nerve
short head of biceps femoris.partOrigin: 股骨粗線外側唇與外側髁上線。
short head of biceps femoris.partNerve: 坐骨神經的腓總神經部分。
short head of biceps femoris.partAction: 屈膝、屈膝位使小腿外旋；不跨髖關節，不能伸髖。
short head of biceps femoris.partInsertion: head of fibula and lateral condyle of the tibia

medial head of gastrocnemius.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 gastrocnemius 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
medial head of gastrocnemius.origin: femur; medial head: above the medial femoral condyle; lateral head: above the lateral femoral condyle
medial head of gastrocnemius.insertion: dorsum of the calcaneus via the calcaneal (Achilles') tendon
medial head of gastrocnemius.partOrigin: 股骨內側髁附近的後面。
medial head of gastrocnemius.partInsertion: dorsum of the calcaneus via the calcaneal (Achilles') tendon

lateral head of gastrocnemius.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 gastrocnemius 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
notes: 「本分部起點」適用於選取的肌頭／分部；整肌資料不等於每一分部都具有全部附著。
lateral head of gastrocnemius.origin: femur; medial head: above the medial femoral condyle; lateral head: above the lateral femoral condyle
lateral head of gastrocnemius.insertion: dorsum of the calcaneus via the calcaneal (Achilles') tendon
lateral head of gastrocnemius.partOrigin: 股骨外側髁附近的後面。
lateral head of gastrocnemius.partInsertion: dorsum of the calcaneus via the calcaneal (Achilles') tendon

medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.key: medial head of flexor hallucis brevis
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.english: medial head of flexor hallucis brevis
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 flexor hallucis brevis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.origin: cuboid, lateral cuneiform, medial side of the first metatarsal
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.insertion: medial belly: medial side of proximal phalanx of the great toe; lateral belly: lateral side of the proximal phalanx of the great toe
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.action: flexes the metatarsophalangeal joint of the great toe
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.nerve: medial plantar nerve (lateral belly occasionally receives innervation from the lateral plantar nerve)
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.partOrigin: 骰骨、外側楔狀骨及脛後肌腱擴展等共同近端附著。
medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.partInsertion: 經內側籽骨至拇趾近節趾骨底內側。

lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.key: lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.english: lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 flexor hallucis brevis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.origin: cuboid, lateral cuneiform, medial side of the first metatarsal
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.insertion: medial belly: medial side of proximal phalanx of the great toe; lateral belly: lateral side of the proximal phalanx of the great toe
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.action: flexes the metatarsophalangeal joint of the great toe
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.nerve: medial plantar nerve (lateral belly occasionally receives innervation from the lateral plantar nerve)
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.partOrigin: 骰骨、外側楔狀骨及脛後肌腱擴展等共同近端附著。
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.partInsertion: 經外側籽骨至拇趾近節趾骨底外側。
lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.partNerve: 通常為內側足底神經；外側頭可另接受外側足底神經分支。

oblique head of adductor hallucis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 adductor hallucis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
oblique head of adductor hallucis.origin: oblique head: bases of metatarsals 2-4; transverse head: heads of metatarsals 3-5
oblique head of adductor hallucis.insertion: lateral side of base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe
oblique head of adductor hallucis.action: adducts the great toe (moves it toward midline of the foot; i.e.toward the 2nd digit)
oblique head of adductor hallucis.nerve: deep branch of the lateral plantar nerve
oblique head of adductor hallucis.partOrigin: 第二至第四蹠骨底與腓骨長肌腱鞘。
oblique head of adductor hallucis.partInsertion: 拇趾近節趾骨底外側，與外側籽骨相關。
oblique head of adductor hallucis.partAction: 內收拇趾並協助足弓穩定。

transverse head of adductor hallucis.dataScope: 以下起止點、神經與作用是 adductor hallucis 的整肌／肌群資料；本分部的補充見下方。
transverse head of adductor hallucis.origin: oblique head: bases of metatarsals 2-4; transverse head: heads of metatarsals 3-5
transverse head of adductor hallucis.insertion: lateral side of base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe
